name: AlphaGenome
input_language: DNA sequence up to 1 Mb
output_language: base-resolution regulatory tracks, expression and splicing predictions, and variant-effect scores
scale: 1 Mb context; 5,930 human and 1,128 mouse genomic signals
why_it_matters: A unified long-context sequence-to-function model linking DNA to several regulatory readouts through one interface.

name: Evo 2
input_language: single-nucleotide DNA sequence
output_language: sequence likelihoods, embeddings, variant effects, annotations, and generated DNA
scale: 7B and 40B parameters; 9.3T tokens; up to 1M-token context
why_it_matters: An open genome-scale model spanning all domains of life and several scales of the central dogma.

name: GET
input_language: accessible-region × transcription-factor motif matrices across genomic loci
output_language: regulatory activity, gene expression, regulators, and regulatory interactions
scale: pretrained across 213 human fetal and adult cell types
why_it_matters: A direct bridge from cell-contextual regulatory syntax to transcriptional output.

name: Nucleotide Transformer
input_language: tokenized DNA sequence
output_language: contextual nucleotide embeddings and task-adapted genomic predictions
scale: 50M–2.5B parameters; 3,202 human genomes and 850 diverse species
why_it_matters: A widely reused family for studying scale, species diversity, transfer, and variant prioritization in DNA models.

name: Caduceus
input_language: single-base DNA sequence with reverse-complement symmetry
output_language: bidirectional long-range DNA representations
scale: state-space models with contexts up to 131 kb
why_it_matters: Builds reverse-complement equivariance into a long-range DNA backbone rather than learning it only from augmentation.

name: HyenaDNA
input_language: single-nucleotide DNA sequence
output_language: long-range sequence representations and genomic predictions
scale: contexts from 1 kb to 1 Mb with subquadratic sequence operators
why_it_matters: An influential demonstration that million-base contexts can be modeled at single-nucleotide resolution without standard attention.

name: DNABERT-2
input_language: BPE-tokenized multi-species DNA
output_language: DNA embeddings and fine-tuned genome classification predictions
scale: 117M parameters; benchmarked across 36 datasets and 9 tasks
why_it_matters: Popularized learned subword tokenization and a broad multi-species evaluation suite for DNA language models.

name: GPN-MSA
input_language: whole-genome multispecies nucleotide alignment
output_language: genome-wide variant-effect likelihoods
scale: alignment-conditioned DNA model evaluated genome-wide
why_it_matters: Makes evolutionary alignment an explicit input language for genome-wide variant scoring.

name: TranscriptFormer
input_language: ordered gene identities paired with expression counts
output_language: cell embeddings, contextual gene embeddings, and generative transcriptome likelihoods
scale: up to 112M cells across 12 species and 1.53B years of evolution
why_it_matters: A cross-species generative cell atlas that initializes gene identity from protein representations.

name: Stack
input_language: contextual chunks of cell × gene expression matrices
output_language: cell representations and generated cell profiles for unseen conditions
scale: 149M uniformly processed human cells
why_it_matters: Introduces in-context learning in which neighboring example cells guide zero-shot condition transfer.

name: State
input_language: basal single-cell transcriptomes plus genetic, chemical, or signaling perturbations
output_language: predicted perturbed transcriptomes and cell embeddings
scale: embedding models to 600M parameters; transition models trained on large perturbation atlases
why_it_matters: Separates cell-state representation from the transition induced by a perturbation.

name: CellFM
input_language: single-cell gene-expression values
output_language: cell and gene representations for annotation, perturbation, function, and networks
scale: 800M parameters; about 100M human cells
why_it_matters: A large value-projection cell model using a retention-based backbone rather than a standard transformer alone.

name: scFoundation
input_language: read-depth-aware single-cell gene-expression vectors
output_language: gene and cell representations plus reconstructed expression
scale: 100M parameters; more than 50M human single-cell transcriptomes
why_it_matters: An influential large-scale encoder-decoder model that explicitly represents sequencing depth.

name: scGPT
input_language: gene tokens, expression values, and optional modality or batch tokens
output_language: cell and gene representations, reconstructed profiles, and multi-omics predictions
scale: pretrained on more than 33M cells
why_it_matters: A widely reused generative backbone with explicit single-cell multi-omics tasks.

name: Geneformer
input_language: rank-ordered expressed-gene tokens for each cell
output_language: contextual gene and cell embeddings with in-silico perturbation readouts
scale: initially pretrained on about 30M human single-cell transcriptomes
why_it_matters: Established rank-value encoding and transfer learning for gene-network questions in single cells.

name: Universal Cell Embedding (UCE)
input_language: expression-weighted gene tokens initialized by protein embeddings and ordered by chromosome
output_language: species-transferable cell embeddings
scale: trained across 36M cells from eight species
why_it_matters: Uses protein-language embeddings as a gene vocabulary to support zero-shot transfer across species.

name: scPRINT
input_language: gene identity, expression, and genomic-position embeddings
output_language: cell labels, denoised expression, embeddings, and cell-specific gene networks
scale: 2M–100M parameters; more than 50M cells and about 80B tokens
why_it_matters: Combines transcript counts, genomic location, and protein-derived gene embeddings for network-centered cell modeling.

name: ESM3
input_language: aligned protein sequence, structure, and function tracks
output_language: conditionally generated protein sequence, structure, and function
scale: model family up to 98B parameters; 1.4B open checkpoint
why_it_matters: A prominent any-to-any multimodal protein model for representation and design.

name: DPLM-2
input_language: amino-acid tokens and quantized 3D structure tokens
output_language: joint or conditional protein sequences and structures
scale: multimodal discrete diffusion initialized from protein sequence models
why_it_matters: Learns the joint sequence–structure distribution with diffusion for folding, inverse folding, and scaffolding.

name: BioEmu
input_language: protein sequence embeddings
output_language: samples from a protein's conformational ensemble
scale: generates thousands of conformations from a single sequence encoding
why_it_matters: Extends the protein language from a static structure to an ensemble of thermally accessible conformations.

name: SaProt
input_language: amino acids paired with Foldseek 3Di structure tokens
output_language: structure-aware protein representations
scale: model family to 650M parameters trained on sequence–structure corpora
why_it_matters: Shows a compact way to inject local structural vocabulary into protein language modeling.

name: ESM-2
input_language: amino-acid sequence
output_language: residue and protein embeddings, sequence likelihoods, and structure predictions through ESMFold
scale: 8M–15B parameter family trained on hundreds of millions of sequences
why_it_matters: A foundational protein representation family reused as a component in many later omics models.

name: ProTrek
input_language: protein sequence, 3Di structure sequence, or natural-language function
output_language: a shared retrieval space across sequence, structure, and function
scale: 35M and 650M checkpoints; search embeddings for billions of proteins
why_it_matters: A clear example of alignment across protein sequence, structure, and human-readable function.

name: MSFM-Proteomics
input_language: tandem mass spectra
output_language: spectrum embeddings for quality, chimericity, phosphorylation, and glycosylation tasks
scale: spectrum encoder pretrained through de novo peptide sequencing
why_it_matters: Targets measured proteomics spectra directly rather than treating protein sequence models as proteomics models.

name: Orthrus
input_language: mature RNA isoform sequence
output_language: functional and evolutionary RNA representations and property predictions
scale: trained on splice isoforms from 10 organisms and orthologs from more than 400 mammals
why_it_matters: Uses isoform and orthology-aware contrastive learning tailored to mature RNA biology.

name: RiNALMo
input_language: single-nucleotide RNA sequence
output_language: RNA embeddings and structure/function predictions
scale: 650M parameters; 36M non-coding RNA sequences
why_it_matters: A large RNA-specific encoder with strong cross-family structural generalization.

name: ERNIE-RNA
input_language: RNA sequence with structure-enhanced pairwise pretraining
output_language: RNA embeddings and zero-shot or fine-tuned structure predictions
scale: structure-aware RNA language model trained on large unlabeled sequence corpora
why_it_matters: Makes pairwise structural dependencies part of RNA pretraining rather than only a downstream head.

name: RNA-FM
input_language: single-nucleotide RNA sequence
output_language: general-purpose RNA embeddings for structure and function tasks
scale: about 100M parameters; 23M non-coding RNA sequences
why_it_matters: An early RNA-specific foundation model and a common baseline for later RNA encoders.

name: EpiAgent
input_language: TF-IDF-ranked accessible cis-regulatory-element tokens per cell
output_language: cell embeddings, imputed accessibility, perturbation response, and cCRE knockout effects
scale: pretrained on more than 5.4M human scATAC-seq cells
why_it_matters: Treats single-cell chromatin accessibility as its own cell language with regulatory perturbation tasks.

name: EpiGePT
input_language: DNA sequence plus transcription-factor context
output_language: cell-context-specific epigenomic tracks and regulatory interactions
scale: 128 kb regions; expanded pretrained model covers 105 cell types
why_it_matters: Separates cis sequence from trans cellular context in sequence-to-epigenome prediction.

name: ChromFound
input_language: genome-aware single-cell chromatin-accessibility tokens
output_language: cell representations, annotations, cross-omics predictions, and enhancer–gene links
scale: 1.97M cells across 30 tissues and 6 disease contexts
why_it_matters: Uses genome-aware tokenization to address the high dimensionality and nonstandard feature space of scATAC-seq.

name: Nicheformer
input_language: ranked gene-expression tokens with species, assay, and spatial/dissociated modality context
output_language: cell embeddings carrying spatial context and niche, region, or neighborhood predictions
scale: SpatialCorpus-110M: about 57M dissociated and 54M spatial cells
why_it_matters: Directly demonstrates that dissociated-only pretraining cannot recover all spatial microenvironment information.

name: scGPT-spatial
input_language: spatial expression profiles and sampled neighborhoods
output_language: spatial representations, integration, deconvolution, and missing-gene imputation
scale: continual pretraining on SpatialHuman30M
why_it_matters: Shows continual adaptation of a single-cell foundation model to explicit spatial objectives and assays.

name: SpatialFormer
input_language: gene expression, subcellular gene positions, and cell-pair neighborhoods
output_language: single-cell spatial embeddings and molecular or cellular proximity predictions
scale: 700M cell pairs from 17M spatial cells across 71 Xenium slides
why_it_matters: Models subcellular molecular position and multicellular neighborhoods in one spatial backbone.

name: spEMO
input_language: spatial gene/protein expression, histopathology embeddings, and text-derived embeddings
output_language: spatial domains, cell types, slide-level predictions, interaction inference, and reports
scale: integrates pretrained pathology and language-model embeddings across spatial multi-omic datasets
why_it_matters: An explicit tissue-level bridge among spatial molecular measurements, morphology, and language.

name: DreaMS
input_language: tandem mass-spectrum peaks and intensities
output_language: molecular spectrum embeddings for annotation, retrieval, networking, and property prediction
scale: self-supervised pretraining on millions of public MS/MS spectra
why_it_matters: Learns reusable molecular representations directly from largely unannotated metabolomics spectra.

name: LSM-MS2
input_language: tandem mass spectra
output_language: semantic spectral embeddings for identification and biological prediction
scale: trained on millions of spectra
why_it_matters: Extends spectral representation learning toward both chemical identification and downstream biological interpretation.

name: MSAlign
input_language: DreaMS spectrum embeddings and ChemBERTa molecular embeddings
output_language: a shared spectrum–molecule retrieval space
scale: lightweight alignment of two frozen foundation models
why_it_matters: A literal metabolomics translator aligning an observed fragmentation pattern with candidate chemical structures.

name: MIMIC
input_language: arbitrary observed subsets of sequence, structure, regulation, evolution, and experimental context
output_language: reconstructed or generated missing biomolecular modalities
scale: 1B-parameter generative model trained on the aligned LORE dataset
why_it_matters: A current prototype of any-subset-to-any-subset biomolecular translation; evidence remains preprint-stage.

name: LucaOne
input_language: nucleic-acid or protein sequence with type embeddings
output_language: unified sequence representations and cross-molecule predictions
scale: 1.8B parameters; 36.95B tokens from 169,861 species
why_it_matters: Trains DNA, RNA, and protein alphabets together and tests emergent central-dogma relationships.

name: CAPTAIN
input_language: co-assayed single-cell RNA and surface-protein abundance
output_language: joint cell embeddings, expanded protein profiles, integration, and cell-communication predictions
scale: scT&P-4M: more than 4.2M co-profiled human and mouse cells and 382 proteins
why_it_matters: A direct single-cell transcriptome–surface-proteome alignment and imputation model.

name: CellWhisperer
input_language: bulk or single-cell transcriptomes paired with textual descriptions
output_language: shared transcriptome–text embeddings, retrieval, annotation, and natural-language dialogue
scale: about 1.08M transcriptome–text pairs plus a Mistral-7B chat adapter
why_it_matters: Makes the translation metaphor literal by mapping measured transcriptomes into a natural-language interface.
